speaker: Damián
cn: 你这种答应我结婚，却出轨的贱人也敢说我是渣男？
en: You agreed to marry me, then cheated on me—and you have the nerve to call me a scumbag?

speaker: 员工二
en: (With disdain) I'd break up too if I were him.

speaker: Damián
en: (with disdain) And besides, I'm already married.

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （震惊）你结婚了？哪个女人能看上你！
en: (Shocked) You're married? Which woman could possibly be interested in you?

speaker: Damián
cn: 这就不关你的事了。现在我正式通知你，我们分手。现在我是你的组长，半个小时内，立刻整理出一份你的工作清单交给我！
en: That’s none of your business. And as of now, we’re done. I’m your team lead, so you have thirty minutes to put together a full list of your tasks and get it to me.

speaker: 员工一
cn: （惊慌）组长，不好了！公司的系统被黑客入侵了！
en: (In panic) Damián, our system has been hacked!

speaker: Eloísa
cn: 没按流程提交安全补丁，被黑客钻了空子。
en: Sorry... I didn’t follow the proper process for submitting the security patch, which left an opening for hackers.

speaker: Damián
cn: （嘲讽）Eloísa，你身为技术员，居然能发生这么大的失误！麻烦是你惹出来，你就给我处理好，否则，这工作你也不用干了！
en: (Mockingly) Eloísa, you’re a technician. How could you make such serious mistake? You caused this mess, so fix it. Otherwise, you’re fired.

speaker: 员工一
cn: （不屑）就这技术，她是怎么进的我们公司啊？
en: (With disdain) Do you see what she's doing now? How did she even get hired by our company?

speaker: 员工二
cn: （讥讽）你不知道吗？她跟部长还有一腿呢！
en: (Mockingly) You didn’t know? She’s sleeping with the department head, too!

speaker: Damián(VO)
cn: 没想到，Eloísa竟然还跟部长出轨了，她到底有几个情人？
en: I didn't expect Eloísa to have an affair with the head of the department—how many lovers does she have?

speaker: Mirella
cn: （沉声）你们部门怎么干活的？已经十分钟了！再这样下去，我们公司的损失将会很大！
en: (sternly): What the hell is your department doing? It’s been ten minutes! Every minute this goes on is costing the company a fortune!

speaker: Mirella
cn: 总裁说了，谁能修复好bug，就奖励五万奖金。（看Damián，意味深长）某位刚来的，总裁在等着看你表现呢。
en: The CEO says whoever fixes the bug gets a $50,000 bonus.

speaker: Eloísa
cn: （不屑）我劝你还是省省吧，这个等级的病毒你是破解不了的！别到时候病毒没解开，工作再丢了！
en: (with disdain) Don’t waste your time. There’s no way you can crack a virus this advanced! You’ll be lucky if you don’t lose your job trying.

speaker: Damián（VO）
cn: 不愧是顶级黑客能力，这些bug在我眼里简直是小意思。
en: As expected—top-tier hacking skills. Easy fix.
